instruction: Create local folders called CONTACTS and IMPORTANT in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders (CONTACTS and IMPORTANT) in Thunderbird. The evaluator reuses the existing check_list metric function to verify that both the folder files and .msf index files exist for both folders using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Regex patterns are semantically correct for verifying Thunderbird folder creation
Pattern 1 '\bCONTACTS\.msf\b' correctly matches the CONTACTS.msf index file
Pattern 2 '\bCONTACTS:' correctly matches the directory marker in ls -R output (no trailing word boundary, so it will match 'CONTACTS:' at end of line)
Pattern 3 '\bIMPORTANT\.msf\b' correctly matches the IMPORTANT.msf index file
Pattern 4 '\bIMPORTANT:' correctly matches the directory marker in ls -R output (no trailing word boundary, so it will match 'IMPORTANT:' at end of line)
Coverage is complete - evaluator checks both folders (CONTACTS and IMPORTANT) and verifies both .msf index files and directory existence
check_list metric function logic is correct - it searches each line for regex matches using pattern.search() and verifies all expected patterns are found
postconfig correctly captures the directory listing with 'ls -R' and saves to cache file
get_cache_file getter correctly retrieves the ls output from cache
The evaluator can semantically verify that both Thunderbird folders were created successfully
